name: 16521-multiturn-qwen25-7b-1gpu
architecture: Qwen2ForCausalLM, 28 layers, 28 query heads / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 3584, vocab 152064, bf16
workload: eight-turn chat sessions, ~256 new user tokens and ~1024 generated tokens per turn, sixteen sessions in flight
purpose: A multi-turn chat assistant on a 7B model, sixteen concurrent eight-turn sessions with long replies, single GPU.
launch:
# One H100 serving Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to sixteen concurrent eight-turn chat sessions.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# Turn 7 is the longest prompt this workload can present, ~11.5k tokens; the checkpoint's own
# 32768 would size buffers this workload never reaches.
context-length: 16384

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
